messages:
Ming - PartnerEng: Quick sync requested — IntegratorX co-sell for ACME. Need to lock crediting + handoff sequence before next week's joint demo. Proposal attached inline.
Sam T: +1 we should make this procedural. small changes to deal stage should trigger partner handoff automations.
Lorenzo (IntegratorX): Thanks — what are the thresholds for SI credit? introduced vs assisted?
Ming - PartnerEng: Suggested split: introduced lead = 30% booking credit for first year (referral), assisted co-sell = 10% credit. If SI runs the POC, bump to 40%. Open to tweaks.
Anya V - GTM: Timeline / SLA idea: AE tags #si-handoff and sets deal stage to "SI Intake" -> SI has 48h to acknowledge in thread and create a partner plan doc. If no ack, AE can proceed and record reason.
Jordan - Sales: CRM issue: our ERP blocks stage change if account owner differs. We need mapping rule: if account exists and owner != SI, create a sub-opportunity tagged "SI-engage" instead of changing owner.
Ming - PartnerEng: Good call. Proposed mapping rules (quick):
```
if account.exists and owner != integrator.owner:
  create opportunity.subtype = "SI-engage"
  tag = "si:IntegratorX"
else:
  set owner = integrator.owner
  tag = "si:IntegratorX-primary"
```
Lorenzo (IntegratorX): That works. How do we record credit provenance so finance can split commission? A simple custom field on opp?
Sam T: add fields: partner_introducer (string), partner_role (introduced|assisted|poc_lead), partner_credit_pct (number). Fill on handoff and lock once opp moves to "Agreement" stage.
Anya V - GTM: For marketplace/listing coordination: marketing will need a short co-branded one-pager and a joint blurb for the cloud marketplace. Timeline: we can push a draft within 3 business days after SI ack.
Jordan - Sales: Automation ask: PartnerBot should create a ticket in partner-intake and ping #engagement-playbooks on ack. Can we wire that?
PartnerBot: auto-note: created partner-intake ticket 87821 for ACME / IntegratorX. Assigned to @Lorenzo (IntegratorX).
Ming - PartnerEng: Agreement summary (finalizing): 1) Crediting bands: introduced 30%, assisted 10%, POC-led 40%. 2) Handoff trigger: AE tags #si-handoff + stage -> PartnerBot creates intake ticket. 3) CRM mapping: create sub-opportunity for existing-account handoffs. 4) SLA: 48h ack by SI, else AE proceeds with note. 5) Finance fields: partner_introducer, partner_role, partner_credit_pct locked at Agreement. 6) Marketplace: marketing draft within 3 business days post-ack.
Lorenzo (IntegratorX): :thumbsup: we accept. I'll ack in the intake ticket and upload our POC plan.
Sam T: I'll draft the short-run automation spec for PartnerBot and ping @Platform to add the CRM sub-opportunity flow.
Ming - PartnerEng: Perfect. Going to capture this in the playbook and circulate. Thanks everyone :rocket:
